description: Get a single saved mission-test config by ID. Returns the full row: name, description, phoneNumber, sector, mission, acceptance, profileId, tags, createdAt, updatedAt. Use when: you have a config ID (typically from listMissionTestConfigs or from a run.configId field) and want to inspect the persona / mission / acceptance criterion text — for example before launching a new run or to explain to the user how a previous run was configured. Cross-tool: for run history launched from this config, use listTestRuns?configId=X. For the run that produced a specific verdict, use getMissionTestRun. Configs can be edited (in the web app, or PATCH /testing/mission-test-configs/{id} on the REST API; no MCP tool saves an edit); `updatedAt` is the time of the last edit and may differ from `createdAt`. Cross-workspace returns 404.
name: getMissionTestConfig

outputSchema.description:
Saved mission-test configuration (Phase 60.1). Lets a user store sector/mission/
acceptance/profile/phoneNumber and re-launch with one click via
`POST /testing/mission-test-configs/{id}/runs`.

allOf.description:
Optional advanced turn-detection overrides for a single mission test.
Mirrors `api/packages/schemas/entities/missionAdvancedParams.ts` (Zod).
All-or-nothing: every field is required when this object is present —
this is what makes it safe for the values to be sent to Telnyx as a
single per-call block regardless of whether Telnyx merges into or
replaces the stored assistant's turn-detection settings. Omit the
object entirely to keep the server's env-var defaults.

eagerEotThreshold.description:
Lets the assistant start preparing a reply before it is sure the
other side has finished (0.3-0.9). It does not make the assistant
wait longer; `eotThreshold` does. Equal to `eotThreshold` switches
early preparation off.

eotThreshold.description:
The main control: how confident the assistant must be that the
other side has finished speaking before it replies (0.5-0.9). 0.9
waits longest and interrupts least; 0.5 replies at almost any pause.

eotTimeoutMs.description:
The longest the assistant sits through silence, in milliseconds,
before replying anyway. A ceiling, not a minimum wait: raising it
does not stop interruptions.

advancedParams.description:
Optional per-call turn-detection overrides. Absent means
mission-tester keeps its env-var defaults.

allOf.description:
Caller background noise: café chatter, city street traffic, home (children and a
baby crying) or wind buffeting. The level is fixed per sound.

backgroundNoise.description: Caller background noise played under the call. Omit for none.

carrierRouteId.description:
Bring-your-own-carrier (invite-only). Dial this config's runs through one of the workspace's
carrier routes, over the workspace's own SIP trunk, instead of nopaque's network. Carrier
routes are set up with nopaque. A mission with a route dials through it or not at all:
if the route cannot be dialled when the run starts, the run is refused and the number is
never called normally. It is checked when the config is saved and resolved again at every launch.
Carrier calls are metered as `carrier_s2stest`, from
answer, and count toward the trunk's daily minutes.

createdBy.description:
Set only on a config created by a sheet import (`POST /imports/{id}/commit`): the id of
the person whose commit created it. Absent on configs created any other way.

allOf.description:
The language a mission test call is held in. These are the languages
Telnyx `deepgram/flux` accepts on the AI Assistant: one language, or
`multi` (Flux-multi), which code-switches across the other ten. Absent
means English. Mirrors `api/packages/schemas/entities/callLanguage.ts`
(Zod). Distinct from the transcription languages standard tests and
mapping use (`en-GB` etc.).

language.description: The call language. Absent means English.

maxDurationSecs.description:
Optional per-call duration cap in seconds. Omit to use the
server default for the mission kind (freeform 180s, compliance 90s).
Raise it for flows that collect a lot of data — a booking that needs
name, date of birth, location and eligibility will not finish in 180s.
Up to 1800 (30 minutes).

scheduleId.description:
The schedule that runs this mission test automatically. Absent means manual runs only.
A scheduled run waits for a free mission test slot like any other mission run, and a
fire is skipped while the previous scheduled run of the same config is still waiting.

tags.description:
Optional, lowercase, dash-or-alphanumeric workspace-scoped tags.
Up to 10. Use the listMissionTestConfigs ?tag= filter to find
configs by tag (single-tag exact match).

voiceId.description:
Telnyx voice id for the call, from the operator-enabled catalogue
(`GET /testing/voices`). Omit to use the configured default voice.

title: Get Mission Test Config
